neighbours.label: Right after a distance in kilometres or miles (or a km/h-mph speed), the slot where its conversion goes: the opening bracket, slash or ', or' and the first digits of the converted number, e.g. a ride of 14 km (9 miles); the bracket fires even when no conversion follows it. Weaker (about 0.3-0.5) after other measures: kilograms, metres/feet, hectares, nautical miles, and 'pounds' even as money. Quiet for temperature, litres, plain money, a bracket after a count of people or after an ordinary word, and a distance with no bracket after it.
neighbours.short: slot after a km/miles distance where its conversion goes
fire: A pint of cider costs 4 pounds (5 dollars) at that pub.
We cycled a ride of 14 km (9 miles) along the canal before lunch.
The trail climbs steadily for 26 miles (42 km) through the pine forest.
Speed limits on the motorway are 120 km/h (75 mph) unless signs say otherwise.
The village lies about 300 km, or 186 miles, north of the capital.
Her daily commute is 8 miles / 13 km each way.
The marathon route covers 42.2 km (26.2 miles) of city streets.
The bridge spans roughly 5 kilometres (3 miles) across the bay.
